- Devouring Swarm (1BB)

Actually, I should wait to see what opponent plays on their turn before deciding what to remove with Chains. Also, Devouring Swarm is a creature that can attack next turn.

I think I'll play Thriving Moor choosing black, then cast Devouring Swarm (2/1 flying). That gives me pressure in the air.

My turn 5. I drew Plaguecrafter! Excellent card. My lands untapped: Plains, 2 Swamps, Thriving Moor. I have 4 untapped lands, can cast either Devouring Swarm or Plaguecrafter.

Plaguecrafter (2B) forces each player to sacrifice a creature or planeswalker. Opponent has Dragonloft Idol (artifact creature). I have no creatures. So opponent sacrifices Dragonloft Idol, I discard a card (since I can't sacrifice). That's good - removes their creature, I discard something less useful.

Devouring Swarm (1BB) gives me a 2/1 flying creature that can grow. But Plaguecrafter seems better - removes their threat and I can discard Chains of Custody (since I have no creatures to enchant) or Captivating Unicorn (5 mana expensive).

Actually, Plaguecrafter makes me discard a card. I have Chains (needs creature), Captivating Unicorn (5 mana), Devouring Swarm (creature). I could discard Chains since I can't use it without a creature.

But wait, I could cast Devouring Swarm first, then Plaguecrafter. That gives me a creature to sacrifice to Plaguecrafter instead of discarding. Sequence: Cast Devouring Swarm (1BB), then Plaguecrafter (2B). I have 4 lands: Plains (W), Swamp (B), Swamp (B), Thriving Moor (B+W). Devouring Swarm requires BB. I need to tap Swamp + Thriving Moor for black. Then Plaguecrafter requires 2B - I can tap Plains + other Swamp.

Yes, that's better! Have a creature to sacrifice, opponent sacrifices Dragonloft Idol. Net result: I get 2/1 flyer, they lose 2/2 creature.

Let's do that. Cast Devouring Swarm first.

I'll cast Chains on Coalborn Entity.

toolCalls.arguments: {"message":"CAPTIVATING UNICORN GALLOPS INTO THE FRAY! DSV3 Stoic weaves white magic, summoning the 4/4 celestial steed to the stack—its constellation aura promises to tap down threats upon enchantment arrivals, bolstering the defense with Plaguecrafter's menace! Grok4F ESPN, with Wildfire Elemental vigilant and Hellkite Punisher simmering in hand, passes the ethereal incursion—the lone untapped Mountain pulses with restrained fury. The crowd gasps at the unicorn's luminous charge; a mythical twist in the plague-ridden melee! WHAT GRACE UNDER FIRE!"}

args.message: CAPTIVATING UNICORN GALLOPS INTO THE FRAY! DSV3 Stoic weaves white magic, summoning the 4/4 celestial steed to the stack—its constellation aura promises to tap down threats upon enchantment arrivals, bolstering the defense with Plaguecrafter's menace! Grok4F ESPN, with Wildfire Elemental vigilant and Hellkite Punisher simmering in hand, passes the ethereal incursion—the lone untapped Mountain pulses with restrained fury. The crowd gasps at the unicorn's luminous charge; a mythical twist in the plague-ridden melee! WHAT GRACE UNDER FIRE!

args.message: CAPTIVATING UNICORN RESOLVES IN CELESTIAL SPLENDOR! The 4/4 unicorn prances onto DSV3 Stoic's side, its constellation gaze scanning for enchantment triggers to tap down the fiery foes—summoning sickness keeps it leashed for now, but paired with Chains of Custody's ward and Plaguecrafter's sacrifice sting, the defense fortifies! Grok4F ESPN, with Wildfire Elemental unflinching and the untapped Mountain brimming, passes the mythical intrusion—no counters in hand, but the dragon's fury ferments for the flip side! The crowd oohs at the unicorn's ethereal entry; a divine detour in the draconic duel!
